title: Other Long Vowel Teams & Diphthongs
source: Science of Reading Level 9 Teacher Guide

units.title: /ū/: oo
units.summary: Lesson 1. oo spells /ū/ (moon, food, zoom, pool). The sound /ū/ can also be spelled ew, ue and ui. Connect the word too to its meaning. High-frequency words: too, soon.

lessons.title: Warm-up
lessons.notes: Sound deck flip and auditory drill; mix in words from earlier units (ai, oa) to keep retrieval sharp.

lessons.title: Teaching skill and model
lessons.notes: oo says /ū/ as in moon, food and zoom. There are two long u sounds, /ū/ and /yū/.

lessons.title: Encoding and decoding
lessons.notes: Sound boxes and mapping; read and spell words from the list.

lessons.title: Guided practice
lessons.notes: Word lists, sentences, dictation.

lessons.title: High-frequency words
lessons.notes: too, soon

objectives.text: read words like moon, food, zoom and pool with oo saying /ū/
spell words such as spoon, roof and broom using oo
read the common words too and soon
say that oo can say /ū/ as in moon

units.title: /ū/ at the end: ew and ue
units.summary: Lessons 2A and 2B. ew and ue spell /ū/ at the end of a word (new, grew, blue, true); /yū/ is usually spelled ue or ew (few, cue). High-frequency words: blue (also new, few).

lessons.title: Warm-up
lessons.notes: Sound deck flip and auditory drill; mix in words from earlier units (ai, oa) to keep retrieval sharp.

lessons.title: Teaching skill and model
lessons.notes: ew and ue spell /ū/ at the end of words (new, flew, blue, glue); ue can also say /yū/ (cue, value).

lessons.title: Encoding and decoding
lessons.notes: Sound boxes and mapping; read and spell words from the list.

lessons.title: Guided practice
lessons.notes: Word lists, sentences, dictation.

lessons.title: High-frequency words
lessons.notes: blue, new, few

objectives.text: read words like new, flew, blue and glue with /ū/ at the end
tell /ū/ in blue from /yū/ in few and cue
spell words such as grew, true, clue and chew using ew or ue
read the common words new, few and blue

replaces: Other Vowels · /ū/ and /yū/: ew, ui, ue

units.title: /ū/ in the middle: ui
units.summary: Lesson 2C (mini-lesson; may be saved for later). ui is the rarest spelling of /ū/ and comes in the middle of a word (fruit, juice, suit).

lessons.title: Warm-up
lessons.notes: Sound deck flip and auditory drill; mix in words from earlier units (ai, oa) to keep retrieval sharp.

lessons.title: Teaching skill and model
lessons.notes: ui spells /ū/ in the middle of a few words (fruit, juice, suit, cruise).

lessons.title: Encoding and decoding
lessons.notes: Sound boxes and mapping; read and spell words from the list.

lessons.title: Guided practice
lessons.notes: Word lists, sentences, dictation.

objectives.text: read words like fruit, juice, suit and bruise with ui saying /ū/
spell fruit and juice by remembering ui
tell ui in the middle of words from ew and ue at the end

units.title: Review of /ū/ graphemes
units.summary: Lesson 2D. Review all the spellings of /ū/: oo, ew, ue and ui, with word sorts and irregular high-frequency words that also have the /ū/ sound.

lessons.title: Review
lessons.notes: Read and spell the graphemes together; sorts and sentences.

lessons.title: Spelling
lessons.notes: Choose the right grapheme by position in the word.

objectives.text: sort /ū/ words by their spelling: oo, ew, ue or ui
choose the right spelling of /ū/ by where it comes in the word
write dictated sentences with /ū/ words

units.title: Short oo
units.summary: Lesson 3. oo has a second sound, short /oo/ (book, foot, wood). High-frequency words: good, look; could, should and would use the letters oul for the same sound.

lessons.title: Warm-up
lessons.notes: Sound deck flip and auditory drill; mix in words from earlier units (ai, oa) to keep retrieval sharp.

lessons.title: Teaching skill and model
lessons.notes: oo can also say the short /oo/ sound (book, look, good). Could, should and would use oul for the same sound.

lessons.title: Encoding and decoding
lessons.notes: Sound boxes and mapping; read and spell words from the list.

lessons.title: Guided practice
lessons.notes: Word lists, sentences, dictation.

lessons.title: High-frequency words
lessons.notes: good, look; irregular: could, would, should

objectives.text: read words like book, look, foot and wood with the short /oo/ sound
tell short oo in book from long oo in moon
read the common words good and look
read could, should and would

units.title: /ô/ in the middle: au
units.summary: Lessons 6A (two options). au spells /ô/ at the beginning or middle of a word (haul, sauce, cause, author). High-frequency words: cause; irregular: caught, laugh. The gh in caught and taught is silent and shows the word is from Old English.
